description: Verified push (t33) and verified idempotent PR creation (t34) proof corpus summary

capability_activation.reason: Verified push (independent ls-remote OID match) and verified idempotent PR creation (queried head OID and repository identity equality) are required before marking delivered. Retries resolve the same PR without duplicates or false success.

known_limitations: The PR protocol uses a provider abstraction (PrProvider interface); production uses GhCliPrProvider with execFileSync('gh', [...]). The protected real-provider run remains in t38.
The push service does not yet wire into the production lifecycle as a complete delivery chain; that integration is t38's scope (the protected vertical slice).
